# DigiVia

> DigiVia L.L.C-FZ is a Dubai (Meydan Free Zone) software and cybersecurity company. It designs, builds and operates custom platforms, web and mobile apps, AI assistants and automation, with a focus on travel and transfer technology.

Contact: info@digivia.ae · WhatsApp +971 55 486 1805 · Meydan Grandstand, 6th floor, Nad Al Sheba, Dubai, UAE · Licence 2649085.01
Languages: English, Turkish, Arabic

## Products

- [Partner Paneli](https://partnelpanel.com): operations platform for transfer companies (bookings, dispatch, flight status, accounting)
- [Welcome Team](https://welcometeam.com.tr): airport meet & greet platform (iOS, Android, web panel, agency API)
- WhatsApp Operations Gateway: self-hosted multi-line WhatsApp panel with REST API and webhooks (demo on request)
